posts.body_html: some new pics of S. leucophylla 'super pink' Baldwin Co, AL, it's a performer year after year! The unique characteristic of this clone in particular is not only the yellowish flower, but also the neon pink interior with a nice contrasting white-ish lid. The shape is also outstanding! I'll see if I can take a better photo of this clone, it's the best pink leuco that I know of. pics taken 10/3/18:
